notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded non-regional IEEE 1516.1-2025 timestamped Delete Object Instance and timestamped Remove Object Instance surfaces to the official C++ declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. The linked Catch2 scenario demonstrates lower-bound validation, pending retraction and reconstitution, exact-bound callback ordering, timestamp/order/retraction propagation, the supplied tag and producing federate, and sender exclusion. Mixed fanout, regional/directed forms, alternate time advances, request-retraction callbacks, save/restore, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual MessageRetractionHandle deleteObjectInstance( ObjectInstanceHandle const & objectInstance, VariableLengthData const & userSuppliedTag, LogicalTime const & time) = 0
tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_federation_management_catch2.cpp::Embedded timestamped Delete Object Instance reconstitutes on retraction and removes before grant
